test_title: SSC CGL Tier 2 English Previous Paper 2 (Held On: 3 Feb 2022)
subject: english
question:
**Given below are four jumbled sentences. Select the option that gives their correct order.**

A. Paper, pencil, whiteboard, and textbook are the tools you need if you want to go to school.

B. But recently, you can add another one to the list: an iPad.

C. But today, it is also being used to make learning fun.

D. The tablet is useful for searching the internet and watching videos.
solution:
The correct answer is __**ABDC**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **A** can be our first part as it contains the subject of the sentence(*Paper, pencil, whiteboard, textbook*). hence it is the best choice for the first part.
 
• **B** further connects the sentence 'A', where another object(*iPad*) is added to the list of tools. Hence, '**B' **is the second part.
 
• **D** has mentioned the *Tablet *which further completes the list of tools. Hence, 'D' and 'C' is the third and fourth part of the sentence respectively.

 

The correct sentence after rearranging the parts: __* Paper, pencil, whiteboard, textbook are the tools you need if you want to go to school, but recently, you can add another one to the list: an iPad. The tablet is useful for searching the internet and watching videos, but today, it is also being used to make learning fun.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0a6c2db12945bba9d674d33112fce66b07f00093d75dae93749f9bdb7bd34e7a.png] **__Hint__**

__
 
• Important Rules to Solve the Para Jumbles:__

 
 
• Read the sentences attentively and try to comprehend the idea or theme of the sentence and eliminate the irrelevant options.
 
• Try to identify the opening( independent sentence) and closing sentences ( concluding sentence).
 
• Try to identify the mandatory pairs. Two sentences can be connected through various connectors and other determinants.
